# HEM v0.6.2b10 — Stable settings and complete configuration paths

## Reliable menus
- Preserve native setting and category DOM identity through unrelated HA updates, including during a mouse press. One click operates each control; open setting info stays open.
- Stable save/retry controls and preserved drafts through asynchronous updates. No synthetic clicks or duplicate device commands.

## Settings coverage and source options
- Home and Room dialogs expose **Refresh sources** with an options-schema refresh that retains edited values and expanded help. Entity membership changes also trigger a bounded refresh; normal value updates do not trigger form recreation.
- **Manage monitored rooms** from Home settings uses the existing backend `choose_rooms` flow, with affirmative acknowledgement before removal; Home Assistant Areas/devices are not deleted.
- The pollen chooser includes compatible numeric index sensors regardless of entity name, but requires explicit selection and valid provider scale for new sources. Unrelated numeric sensors are not auto-selected. Known first-setup pollen and existing saved choices retain legacy behaviour.
- Previously saved missing Home-source IDs remain recognizable as unavailable choices so unrelated edits are not blocked. Newly invalid IDs are not accepted.
- Align pollen scale minimum with runtime (1–100), retaining a previously saved invalid scale when saving unrelated options.
- Paired next-alarm/lead and pollen threshold/scale fields remain pending until jointly valid; backend errors identify the actual Home field.
- Disabled/unavailable registered controls remain discoverable with management guidance, never implied permission or capability grants. Native setting help follows the card language (English, Greek, German), independently of announcement language.
- Purpose-focused help clarifies pollen measurement, thresholds, weather warning availability, wake-source dependency and missing-data consequences.

## Compatibility and safety
No humidity hysteresis/PID, appliance permissions, command dispatch, physical safety protection, energy calculations or Announcement Hub routing changes. Previous settings, IDs and manually disabled controls remain unchanged. No configuration reset required.

## Verification
New deterministic Chromium browser and actual production-method tests cover press/release under refresh, expanded help, same-dialog source refresh, paired-field writes, orphaned sources, monitored-room enrollment/removal consent, translated help and numeric pollen-scale bounds. Standard full CI remains required before publication.

Update via HACS and follow its reload prompt, then refresh the browser. GitHub publication does not install or restart the user's server.
